philosophy.title: What we are building is actually simple
philosophy.body: We do not draw conclusions for you — we just give you another angle to look at yourself. Tool results are reference points, not verdicts; guides are optional, not mandatory. You can always use just the tools without booking a guide. Guide ranking is determined by objective criteria such as ratings and availability, following public rules — the platform does not favor any individual guide.
